title: Security advisories
description: Running images that match a known advisory in your signed feed.
feedError: The feed could not be read: {{error}}
unverifiedNote: Matches are shown, but Refresh needs a verified feed.
offBody: Set APP_ADVISORY_FEED on the server to the URL of a signed advisory feed, then restart. Refresh also needs APP_ADVISORY_REFRESH_ACTION=on.
emptyTitle: No deployed image matches a known advisory
emptyBody: Nothing running is affected by the current feed.
confirmWhat: Looks up the newest digest of the same tag in the registry.
confirmDeploy: Deploys that digest through the normal deploy policy, freeze windows and approvals.
confirmApproval: In a protected environment this creates a pending approval instead of deploying.
confirmNoFix: If the registry has no newer digest, nothing changes and you will see why.
done: {{app}} is being redeployed on the newest digest.
pending: A deploy approval for {{app}} is waiting for review.
